Priya Rao: Follow-up to the Private->Hosted/Dedicated evacuation RFC. Opening a short thread to align on credential safety, observability, and rollout playbook. RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/priv-evacuate-summary
Priya Rao: Problem statement: when a private sidecar is quarantined (network compromise, cert expiry, or KMS outage) we need a safe, auditable way to run inference on Hosted/Dedicated without copying customer-managed keys.
Devon Li: High-level options: 1) Rebind creds (dangerous) 2) Ephemeral token exchange (preferred) 3) Escrow retry proxies (still risky). Thoughts?
Samir Patel: Vote for ephemeral token exchange. Control plane mints an exchange token scoped to inference ops; hosted redeems, gets ephemeral session. TTL short (30–120s). No long-lived keys leave customer boundary.
Anya Kuznetsova: Obs/security: tag all quarantine flows with `quarantine=true` and `tenant_hash=<sha256:8>` in traces. Also redact any headers that might contain PII.
Priya Rao: Rollout plan sketch: feature flag per-tenant -> canary (5–10 tenants) -> 1% traffic sweep -> wider. Abort if: sustained error-rate >5% for 5m, p95 latency >1.5x baseline, or semantic-regression above threshold.
Devon Li: Circuit breaker/variant fallback: if exact model not available on Hosted, route to compatible variant and set `x-rdwd-fallback: 1` header. Console must show variant mapping and confidence.
Samir Patel: Cost/ops note: quarantines shift load to Hosted/Dedicated and create cost spikes. Add billing tag `quarantine.tenant=<id>` and a billing alert. Also surface a short reason string in audit events.
Anya Kuznetsova: Tests: add infra-ci e2e cases for network egress block, KMS downtime during mint, and secret rotation mid-evacuation. Nightly job should validate audit exports remain PI-free.
Priya Rao: Security constraint (hard): do NOT persist customer-managed keys or copy them into Hosted. Use HSM-backed signing in control plane to mint ephemeral exchange tokens. All audit events must include obfuscated tenant id and exchange reason.
Devon Li: Implementation TODOs:
- token-exchange endpoint + JSON schema
- hosted runtime redeem flow + session lifecycle
- console UI: quarantine flag + served-variant visibility
- runbook + playbook for oncall
Samir Patel: I'll own audit event schema and billing tagging. Proposed audit schema fields: `event_type`, `tenant_hash`, `actor`, `outcome`, `reason`. Keep plaintext in event store but encrypted at rest.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staged rollout for feature/priv-evacuate -> build 10021 -> infra-canary -> monitor metrics -> https://ci.redwood/internal/10021
Priya Rao: Runbook snippet for oncall:
```
If errors > 5% -> flip FF off for tenant -> call quarantine.invalidate(<tenant>) -> page security + infra
If token mint fails -> fail-closed (do not issue long-lived fallbacks) -> return 429 with meta about degraded state
If cost > $THRESH/min -> throttle quarantined tenants and notify account owner
```
Anya Kuznetsova: SLO for quarantined traffic: p95 <= 1.5x normal. If exceeded, prefer returning short degrade with reason rather than waiting for long tail. Add alert to paging rules.
Devon Li: Quality tradeoff: allow quantized/approx variants only if semantic-similarity >= 0.92 on tenant-defined prompt set. Add gating evaluation during canary.
Samir Patel: Also ensure quarantine events are copied to immutable compliance stream and available in customer audit export requests (with redaction).
Priya Rao: I'll draft the RFU doc with runbook, gating eval, and owners. Assigning: Devon -> token-exchange PR; Samir -> audit + billing tags; Anya -> tracing + e2e tests. Will post RFC follow-up by EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
